tasks.title: Add app/sitemap.ts using Next.js MetadataRoute convention
tasks.description: Create app/sitemap.ts with a default export typed as MetadataRoute.Sitemap. Import { site } from '@/lib/site' and return a single entry for the root URL (site.url) with lastModified, changeFrequency 'monthly', and priority 1. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for the Next 16 sitemap convention and exact field names before writing. Do not modify lib/site.ts.
acceptance_criteria: File app/sitemap.ts exists and default-exports a function typed with MetadataRoute.Sitemap.
Base URL comes from site.url (imported from @/lib/site), not a hardcoded string.
Sitemap contains exactly one URL entry (the root); no in-page anchor entries.
GET /sitemap.xml returns 200 with Content-Type application/xml and a <loc> equal to site.url.
next build succeeds and the route appears in the build output; typecheck passes.

tasks.title: Add app/robots.ts using Next.js MetadataRoute convention
tasks.description: Create app/robots.ts with a default export typed as MetadataRoute.Robots. Import { site } from '@/lib/site' and return rules { userAgent '*', allow '/', disallow '/api/' } plus sitemap `${site.url}/sitemap.xml`. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for the Next 16 robots convention before writing. Do not add a static public/robots.txt.
acceptance_criteria: File app/robots.ts exists and default-exports a function typed with MetadataRoute.Robots.
Output contains a Sitemap: line pointing to `${site.url}/sitemap.xml`, with the host matching site.url.
No public/robots.txt or public/sitemap.xml is added (no shadowing of generated routes).
next build and typecheck pass; no new dependency added to package.json.

tasks.title: Verify build-time env override and document deploy contract
tasks.description: Confirm both artifacts honor NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL at build time (matching the existing metadataBase behavior) and that the fallback https://portfolio.local appears only when the env var is unset. Add a short note to the changelog / deploy checklist that NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL must be set in production.
acceptance_criteria: Building with NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL set produces sitemap/robots URLs using that domain.
Building without it produces https://portfolio.local (documented fallback), not a crash.
Changelog/deploy note states NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is required for correct production sitemap/robots.
